title: Event file: a JSON array of events

t.description: Year relative to present (negative = ago). For uncertain dates this is the MIDPOINT of the estimate; the event is placed here.

t_err.description: Plus/minus uncertainty in years. Printed alongside the date.

span.description: Optional [start, end] years for a long-lasting phenomenon. t should be its midpoint.

mention.description: For spans only: which entries print. Default (decision #33): ["start", "end"], or ["mid"] when start and end share a page.

sources.description: BibTeX keys in data/sources.bib supporting the date and the facts.

tags.description: Topic tags. Each must be defined in data/tags.json; reuse existing tags before adding new ones.

importance.description: Optional, default 3. Will drive emphasis and who yields in crowded pages.

file.description: Path relative to art/ (use art/line/ variants for consistency).

caption.description: Caption printed beside the drawing: name plus 1-2 sentences. Its facts must be supported by art.sources.

sources.description: Sources (sources.bib keys) for the caption's facts. The image credit itself comes from art/credits.json (decision #40), not from here.

verified.description: true once a human/research session has checked date + citation against the source.
